submission.justification: After comprehensive simulation studies across all three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) and five plate thicknesses (2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 mm), Absorber-F1 at 6 mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.128% at 100 GeV. This represents a significant improvement of 0.772 percentage points over the best F2 configuration (3.9% at 5 mm) and 1.972 percentage points over the best F3 configuration (5.1% at 5 mm). The resolution performance shows an optimal balance at 6 mm thickness, with degradation observed at both thinner (3.812% at 2 mm) and thicker (4.939% at 10 mm) plates. This configuration meets all constraints: plate thickness is within the 2-10 mm range, the material is from the approved candidate list, and achieves the stated goal of best possible energy resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 at 6 mm achieves 3.128% resolution, which is the best result among all 18 simulations performed (3 materials × 6 thicknesses each)
requirements.evidence_source: Simulation results showing best_overall_resolution = 3.128 for material F1 at 6 mm thickness
